lines.text: Materials are the substances from which objects are made, and English has an extensive vocabulary for describing them. Natural materials come from the earth, plants, or animals. Wood — from trees like oak, pine, and mahogany — is used for furniture, flooring, and construction. Stone, marble, and granite are quarried for building and decoration. Metals include iron, steel, copper, aluminium, gold, and silver — each with distinct properties of strength, conductivity, and appearance. Cotton, wool, silk, and linen are natural fibres used in textiles. Leather comes from animal hides and is used for shoes, bags, and upholstery. Synthetic materials are manufactured by humans. Plastic is the most ubiquitous — lightweight, durable, and versatile but environmentally problematic. Nylon, polyester, and acrylic are synthetic fibres found in clothing and furnishings. Rubber provides flexibility and waterproofing. Glass, made from sand, is transparent and used for windows, bottles, and screens. Ceramic and porcelain are clay-based materials for dishes, tiles, and decorative objects. Concrete and cement are essential construction materials. Material properties include: durable (long-lasting), fragile (easily broken), flexible (bendable), rigid (stiff), waterproof (water-resistant), transparent (see-through), opaque (not transparent), and biodegradable (naturally decomposing). Understanding material vocabulary is vital for shopping, construction, fashion, environmental discussions, and everyday descriptions.

lines.text: Environmental awareness has introduced new material terms: 'sustainable', 'eco-friendly', 'biodegradable', 'recyclable', 'compostable', 'carbon-neutral', 'ethically sourced', 'fair-trade'. These are increasingly common on product labels and in English media.

lines.text: 'Made in' refers to the country of manufacture (Made in UK). 'Made of' describes the material (made of cotton). 'Made from' is used when the material is transformed (wine is made from grapes). 'Made with' lists ingredients (made with real leather).
